## The STEMVerse Podcast

The STEMVerse Podcast is hosted by Ineza Mizero Ines Kevine and is designed to promote STEM awareness among young people. The podcast features accomplished women working in Rwanda’s STEM fields, who share their personal journeys, challenges, and successes. By highlighting real stories of resilience and achievement, the podcast seeks to inspire youth—especially young women, to pursue careers in STEM.
The STEMVerse Podcast is currently available on YouTube.

## STEMPossible at GS Gashora

STEMPossible conducts weekly STEM workshops at GS (Groupe Scholaire) Gashora in alignment with the initiative’s broader mission. Each week, a team of moderators travels to the school to engage Grade 8 students in interactive sessions designed to spark interest in STEM during their early academic years.

These workshops emphasize exploration and curiosity, encouraging students to immerse themselves in STEM subjects while building confidence and motivation. The curriculum and additional program details are included in the accompanying documentation.

To further enhance the learning experience, additional funding is needed to acquire hands-on tools that simulate professional equipment used in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics. These resources will allow students to engage more deeply with practical, real-world applications of STEM concepts.

## Share Our Share: Share Your Share Fundraising Initiative

Through the Share Your Share annual fundraising event, Share Our Share seeks to amplify the impact of STEMPossible by addressing barriers beyond access to knowledge. Conversations with students have revealed that financial constraints; particularly school fees and scholastic materials—pose significant challenges to their education.
The Share Your Share initiative was established to help alleviate this burden by raising funds to cover school tuition and provide essential learning materials. By reducing financial stress on families, the program enables students to focus fully on their education and pursue their academic goals without interruption.
